About

Puzzle & Cipher Tools is a free set of puzzle tools for people who like codes, word games, and number grids.

There is no account and nothing to buy. The first version is in English only.

Each tool does its work in your browser. The letters, puzzles, and symbols you type are not uploaded.

  • Morse Code Translator — Turn dots and dashes into words, or words into sound.
  • Anagram Solver — Use every letter to find real words.
  • Unscramble Words — Find every word those letters can spell.
  • Sudoku Solver — Fill a 9 by 9 sudoku or ask for one hint.
  • Maze Generator — Print a maze and its answer.
  • Wingdings Translator — Turn text into symbols and symbols back into text.
  • Word Search Generator — Make a printable word search.
  • Cryptogram Solver — Solve a letter-substitution puzzle.
  • Crossword Solver — Find words that fit the letters you know.
